tools.name: medusa.get_product
tools.description: Fetch Medusa products with their status and trimmed variants. Provide exactly one of product_id or sku. Zero matches is a not_found error.

tools.name: medusa.create_product
tools.description: One draft PRODUCT from structured fields — the catalog entity. Internally the same engine as import_products, idempotent per SKU: sku, title and price are enough to build the draft, and a SKU that already exists returns the existing product — product_id, erp_url, created: false, status unchanged | updated — never a second product; a title, description, price or image that differs from what the product has is applied through the write door and listed in `updated`. A price needs price_source user | sheet. To change an existing product's content, use update_product with its product_id. Never publishes.
